incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for inference-gateway [p99 latency] — SLO burn 5m. alert_id=PD12345 region=us-west service=inference-gateway

pagerduty: Page PD12345 triggered; priority: P1 — waiting for ack

ken: acked — I'm on it, grabbing logs and looking at routing

maria: any customer-facing impact? metrics show increase in 3rd party errors?

ken: quick look — p99 jumped from 280ms -> 1.2s, p95 up to 460ms. traces show hotpath on kv-evict and sidecar backpressure

owen: confirm KV cache eviction spike at 15:41:12, eviction rate x10. Related to a burst of long sequences from region=apac? request_id samples: 0a1b,0a1c

ken: trying quick mitigation — toggling traffic routing to fallback pool (dedicated-1) for 10% of traffic

ken: run: ```curl -XPOST https://ops-api/route/shift -d '{ "service":"inference-gateway", "percent":10, "target":"dedicated-1" }'```

incident-bot: routing change OK (job 67890) — watch p99

maria: pinging CS — @lia can you check if any customers reported errors in last 30m?

lia: putting out a quick note to top 10 customers; haven't seen inbound tickets yet

owen: also seeing batch size autocontrol ramp up then drop — possible hotkey or batcher hysteresis

ken: rolling out emergency config: reduce max-batch-size from 64 -> 32 on hotpath nodes

ken: k8s rollout started for batch-config (deploy/inference-hotpath) — ETA 90s

pagerduty: PD12345 acknowledged by ken at 15:42:05

sarah: (oncall overlap) I'm taking over after you, ken. what's current state?

ken: now p99 -> 850ms from 1.2s, p95 -> 410ms. ded-1 handling 12% traffic, eviction rate halved. still unstable but improving

sarah: ok I'll keep watch, escalate if >1.0s for 5m. lia keep CS loop open. create a postmortem ticket

maria: creating incident ticket INC-2026-78, adding runbook notes and next steps

owen: follow-up: investigate cause of sequence-length burst — correlate with model variant rollout at 15:35

ken: handing off fully to sarah (shift end). leaving temp routing change and batch config in place. :white_check_mark:

sarah: ack handoff. I'll do 15m stabilise and then decide on rollback vs warmup

incident-bot: PD12345 status: acknowledged, acknowledged_by=ken, assignee=sarah, severity=P1

ken: signing off — thanks team

sarah: on it. will update in 10m
